relationships.subject: lipedema
relationships.evidence_quote: Lipedema abdominal skin displayed reduced Tuj-1+ neuronal cell body density, compared to healthy controls, while CGRP and NGF was significantly elevated in Stage 3 lipedema tissues.

relationships.subject: lipedema
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP labeling was significantly higher in stage 3 samples, compared to either control or stage 2 tissues (Figure 6C).

relationships.subject: lipedema
relationships.evidence_quote: In patients with stage 2 or 3 lipedema, compared to controls, significant hypersensitization of the dermis in all affected areas was demonstrated

key_findings: Lipedema pain increases with stage; von Frey shows stage-dependent dermal hypersensitivity.
Abdominal dermal neuronal density reduced; CGRP and NGF elevated in stage 3 skin, lower in stage 1.
